payload.claim: The new per-failure lines this spec adds (PACKAGE's PhaseStart.detail carrying baseline.render(failure), and the finish's per-failure escalate lines) all carry a gate's own failure message text, which is cell-adjacent (tool/test stdout), not host-authored. saffron/events.py's EventLog.append redacts credentials only for Agent events (saffron/events.py:511-545); PhaseStart.detail and the Attempt/GateResult failures fields this spec's finish changes echo are never passed through redact/_redact_nested. This is a pre-existing gap, not introduced by this spec: the identical shape was raised as a concern on the sibling spec SA-0362 (which added the same kind of failures text to Attempt/GateResult) and was explicitly accepted as out of scope there. True but minor, and costs nothing to leave for the operator.
